import QuaternaryQuadraticForms.LocalDensitySummability
import QuaternaryQuadraticForms.LocalDensityCounting
import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic

/-!
# The local density is the limit of the actual zero counts

The finite orthogonality identity and the absolute convergence proved earlier
give a limit of the normalized residue counts at every prime. Because those
counts are real and nonnegative, the complete-sum series has a real,
nonnegative value. This value is the density defined from the counting limit.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace QuaternaryQuadraticForms

open Filter
open scoped BigOperators Topology

private theorem normalized_counts_complex_tendsto (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A k : ℂ)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∑' k : ℕ, localDensityTerm p A k)) := by
  have h := (summable_localDensityTerm p A hA hdet).hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat.comp
    (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  convert h using 1
  funext k
  exact normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount_eq_sum p k A

private theorem normalized_counts_real_tendsto (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A) atTop
      (𝓝 (∑' k : ℕ, localDensityTerm p A k).re) := by
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, Complex.ofReal_re] using
    (Complex.continuous_re.tendsto _).comp
      (normalized_counts_complex_tendsto p A hA hdet)

/-- The local density defined by the actual real counting sequence equals
the real part of the absolutely convergent complete-sum series. -/
theorem localQuadraticDensity_eq_tsum_re (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0) :
    localQuadraticDensity p A = (∑' k : ℕ, localDensityTerm p A k).re :=
  (normalized_counts_real_tendsto p A hA hdet).limUnder_eq

/-- The actual normalized number of zeros modulo `p^k` converges to the
source local density at every prime, including all bad primes. -/
theorem tendsto_normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A) atTop (𝓝 (localQuadraticDensity p A)) := by
  rw [localQuadraticDensity_eq_tsum_re p A hA hdet]
  exact normalized_counts_real_tendsto p A hA hdet

/-- The literal complex complete-sum series has sum equal to the real
density defined by the normalized counts. Its reality is proved by uniqueness
of the limit of those actual counts. -/
theorem hasSum_localDensityTerm (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0) :
    HasSum (localDensityTerm p A) (localQuadraticDensity p A : ℂ) := by
  have hc := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto (localQuadraticDensity p A)).comp
    (tendsto_normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A hA hdet)
  have heq : (∑' k : ℕ, localDensityTerm p A k) = (localQuadraticDensity p A : ℂ) :=
    tendsto_nhds_unique (normalized_counts_complex_tendsto p A hA hdet) hc
  exact heq ▸ (summable_localDensityTerm p A hA hdet).hasSum

/-- The local density is nonnegative because every normalized residue count is. -/
theorem localQuadraticDensity_nonneg (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0) :
    0 ≤ localQuadraticDensity p A := by
  apply ge_of_tendsto (tendsto_normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A hA hdet)
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun k => by
    unfold normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount
    positivity

end QuaternaryQuadraticForms

import QuaternaryQuadraticForms.LocalDensityGaussReduction
import QuaternaryQuadraticForms.CompleteSumSpecializations

/-!
# The finite counting identity for the local density

Composite-modulus additive orthogonality counts the actual zeros. The exact
unit/multiple scalar partition then gives the partial-sum identity at every
prime power, including modulus one and the prime two.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace QuaternaryQuadraticForms

open scoped BigOperators

/-- Additive orthogonality expresses the actual prime-power zero count through
the full scalar Gauss sum. This holds at every positive base modulus. -/
theorem primePowerZeroCount_additive (p k : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) :
    (p : ℂ) ^ k * (primePowerZeroCount p k A : ℂ) =
      ∑ a : ZMod (p ^ k),
        quadraticGaussSum (p ^ k) (A.map (Int.castRingHom _)) a 0 := by
  classical
  have hscalar (c : ZMod (p ^ k)) :
      (∑ a : ZMod (p ^ k), ZMod.stdAddChar (a * c)) =
        if c = 0 then (p : ℂ) ^ k else 0 := by
    simpa only [ZMod.card, apply_ite, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_pow] using
      AddChar.sum_mulShift c (ZMod.isPrimitive_stdAddChar (p ^ k))
  simp only [quadraticGaussSum, zero_dotProduct, add_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [hscalar, ← integralQuadraticValue_residueLift]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  simp [primePowerZeroCount, mul_comm]

/-- The normalized count is exactly the full scalar Gauss sum divided by
`p^(4k)`, with all scalar residues retained. -/
theorem normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount_eq_fullGauss (p k : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) :
    (normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A k : ℂ) =
      (∑ a : ZMod (p ^ k),
        quadraticGaussSum (p ^ k) (A.map (Int.castRingHom _)) a 0) /
        (p : ℂ) ^ (4 * k) := by
  rw [← primePowerZeroCount_additive]
  unfold normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount
  push_cast
  rw [show 4 * k = k + 3 * k by omega, pow_add]
  have hp : (p : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne p)
  field_simp

/-- Increasing the exponent appends exactly the next literal complete-sum
coefficient. No regularity or nonsingularity hypothesis enters this identity. -/
theorem normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount_recurrence (p k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) :
    (normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A (k + 1) : ℂ) =
      (normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A k : ℂ) + localDensityTerm p A (k + 1) := by
  rw [normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount_eq_fullGauss,
    primePower_fullGauss_recurrence, add_div,
    normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount_eq_fullGauss]
  have hp : (p : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
  have hcancel (z : ℂ) :
      (p : ℂ) ^ 4 * z / (p : ℂ) ^ (4 * (k + 1)) =
        z / (p : ℂ) ^ (4 * k) := by
    rw [show 4 * (k + 1) = 4 + 4 * k by omega, pow_add]
    field_simp
  rw [hcancel, add_comm]
  rfl

/-- The zero exponent has its single residue vector and source normalization one. -/
theorem normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount_zero (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) :
    normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A 0 = 1 := by
  simp [normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount, primePowerZeroCount]

/-- The exact finite identity in Lemma 3.8: normalized actual zero counts
are partial sums of the literal complete-sum coefficients. Every prime,
including two, and the boundary exponent zero are covered. -/
theorem normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount_eq_sum (p k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) :
    (normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A k : ℂ) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), localDensityTerm p A j := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      simp [normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount_zero, localDensityTerm,
        unweightedCompleteSum_one]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount_recurrence, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]

end QuaternaryQuadraticForms

import QuaternaryQuadraticForms.IntegralGaussSums
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.Basic

/-!
# The literal local quadratic densities

The finite counts use every residue vector modulo the indicated prime power,
including the origin. The local density is the limit of their normalized real
counts. Its existence and equality with the complete-sum series are proved in
the subsequent modules.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace QuaternaryQuadraticForms

/-- The actual number of zeros of the integral form modulo `p^k`. -/
def primePowerZeroCount (p k : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) : ℕ := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin 4 → ZMod (p ^ k) =>
    (integralQuadraticValue A (residueLift (p ^ k) x) : ZMod (p ^ k)) = 0)).card

/-- The source normalization `p^(-3k) N_(p,k)` as a real number. -/
def normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (primePowerZeroCount p k A : ℝ) / (p : ℝ) ^ (3 * k)

/-- The literal local complete-sum coefficient `S_(p^k)(0)/p^(4k)`. -/
def localDensityTerm (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (k : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  unweightedCompleteSum (p ^ k) A 0 / (p : ℂ) ^ (4 * k)

/-- The local density defined from the actual normalized counting sequence.
Its convergence is established independently, rather than built into this definition. -/
def localQuadraticDensity (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) : ℝ :=
  limUnder Filter.atTop (normalizedPrimePowerZeroCount p A)

end QuaternaryQuadraticForms

import QuaternaryQuadraticForms.LocalDensityGoodPrime
import QuaternaryQuadraticForms.LocalDensityConvergence
import Mathlib.Analysis.PSeries
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Summable

/-!
# The corrected local-density Euler product

The source supplies its Dirichlet character and its Legendre values at good
primes. Every bad-prime factor retains that original character and the actual
counting density. The finite exceptional set requires no nonvanishing or
positivity assumption. Absolute summability of the deviations from one proves
convergence of the corrected product and of its norm product.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace QuaternaryQuadraticForms

open Filter
open scoped BigOperators Topology

/-- The good-prime value of the actual real counting density, viewed in `ℂ`. -/
theorem localQuadraticDensity_goodPrime (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0)
    (hp : ¬p ∣ quadraticBadPrimeModulus A) :
    (localQuadraticDensity p A : ℂ) =
      (1 - (legendreSym p A.det : ℂ) / (p : ℂ) ^ 2) /
        (1 - (legendreSym p A.det : ℂ) / (p : ℂ)) :=
  (hasSum_localDensityTerm p A hA hdet).unique
    (localDensityTerm_hasSum_goodPrime p A hA hp)

/-- The same formula with the manuscript's original supplied character. -/
theorem source_localQuadraticDensity_goodPrime (M : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ)
    (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0)
    (hχ : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime], ¬ℓ ∣ quadraticBadPrimeModulus A →
      χ (ℓ : ZMod M) = (legendreSym ℓ A.det : ℂ))
    (hp : ¬p ∣ quadraticBadPrimeModulus A) :
    (localQuadraticDensity p A : ℂ) =
      (1 - χ (p : ZMod M) / (p : ℂ) ^ 2) / (1 - χ (p : ZMod M) / (p : ℂ)) := by
  rw [hχ p hp]
  exact localQuadraticDensity_goodPrime p A hA hdet hp

/-- Exactly the corrected factor `(1 - χ(p)/p) σ_p` in source `eq:SF`,
including the original character values at bad primes. -/
def correctedLocalDensityFactor (M : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (p : Nat.Primes) : ℂ :=
  letI : NeZero (p : ℕ) := ⟨p.property.ne_zero⟩
  (1 - χ ((p : ℕ) : ZMod M) / ((p : ℕ) : ℂ)) *
    (localQuadraticDensity (p : ℕ) A : ℂ)

/-- At a good prime the correction cancels exactly the nonzero geometric
denominator, leaving `1 - χ(p)/p²`. -/
theorem correctedLocalDensityFactor_goodPrime (M : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0)
    (hχ : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime], ¬ℓ ∣ quadraticBadPrimeModulus A →
      χ (ℓ : ZMod M) = (legendreSym ℓ A.det : ℂ))
    (p : Nat.Primes) (hp : ¬(p : ℕ) ∣ quadraticBadPrimeModulus A) :
    correctedLocalDensityFactor M χ A p =
      1 - χ ((p : ℕ) : ZMod M) / ((p : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ 2 := by
  letI : Fact (p : ℕ).Prime := ⟨p.property⟩
  have hden : 1 - χ ((p : ℕ) : ZMod M) / ((p : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hχ (p : ℕ) hp]
    intro h
    have heq := (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
    have hn := localDensity_goodPrime_ratio_norm_lt_one (p : ℕ) A
    simpa [heq] using hn
  unfold correctedLocalDensityFactor
  rw [source_localQuadraticDensity_goodPrime M χ (p : ℕ) A hA hdet hχ hp]
  field_simp

/-- The good-prime corrected factor differs from one by at most `p⁻²`. -/
theorem correctedLocalDensityFactor_sub_one_norm_le (M : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0)
    (hχ : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime], ¬ℓ ∣ quadraticBadPrimeModulus A →
      χ (ℓ : ZMod M) = (legendreSym ℓ A.det : ℂ))
    (p : Nat.Primes) (hp : ¬(p : ℕ) ∣ quadraticBadPrimeModulus A) :
    ‖correctedLocalDensityFactor M χ A p - 1‖ ≤ 1 / ((p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
  letI : Fact (p : ℕ).Prime := ⟨p.property⟩
  rw [correctedLocalDensityFactor_goodPrime M χ A hA hdet hχ p hp]
  simp only [sub_sub_cancel_left, norm_neg, norm_div, norm_pow, Complex.norm_natCast]
  rw [hχ (p : ℕ) hp]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (legendreSym_complex_norm_le_one (p : ℕ) A.det)
    (sq_nonneg _)

/-- Nonsingularity makes the exceptional prime set finite. -/
theorem eventually_prime_not_dvd_quadraticBadPrimeModulus
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᶠ p : Nat.Primes in cofinite, ¬(p : ℕ) ∣ quadraticBadPrimeModulus A := by
  have hfinite : {p : Nat.Primes | (p : ℕ) ∈ (quadraticBadPrimeModulus A).primeFactors}.Finite :=
    (quadraticBadPrimeModulus A).primeFactors.finite_toSet.preimage
      Subtype.coe_injective.injOn
  rw [eventually_cofinite]
  simp only [not_not]
  exact hfinite.subset fun p hp => Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr
    ⟨p.property, hp, quadraticBadPrimeModulus_ne_zero A hdet⟩

/-- Absolute convergence of the corrected product: the actual deviations
from one are summable over all primes, with every bad factor retained. -/
theorem summable_norm_correctedLocalDensityFactor_sub_one
    (M : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0)
    (hχ : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime], ¬ℓ ∣ quadraticBadPrimeModulus A →
      χ (ℓ : ZMod M) = (legendreSym ℓ A.det : ℂ)) :
    Summable (fun p : Nat.Primes => ‖correctedLocalDensityFactor M χ A p - 1‖) := by
  have hsum : Summable (fun p : Nat.Primes => 1 / ((p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
    (Real.summable_one_div_nat_pow.mpr (by decide : 1 < (2 : ℕ))).comp_injective
      Subtype.coe_injective
  apply hsum.of_norm_bounded_eventually
  filter_upwards [eventually_prime_not_dvd_quadraticBadPrimeModulus A hdet] with p hp
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] using
    correctedLocalDensityFactor_sub_one_norm_le M χ A hA hdet hχ p hp

/-- The product in `eq:SF` exists, including any finite zero bad-prime factor. -/
theorem multipliable_correctedLocalDensityFactor
    (M : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0)
    (hχ : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime], ¬ℓ ∣ quadraticBadPrimeModulus A →
      χ (ℓ : ZMod M) = (legendreSym ℓ A.det : ℂ)) :
    Multipliable (correctedLocalDensityFactor M χ A) := by
  have h := multipliable_one_add_of_summable
    (summable_norm_correctedLocalDensityFactor_sub_one M χ A hA hdet hχ)
  exact h.congr fun p => by ring

/-- The product of the norms of the actual corrected factors also converges. -/
theorem multipliable_norm_correctedLocalDensityFactor
    (M : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0)
    (hχ : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime], ¬ℓ ∣ quadraticBadPrimeModulus A →
      χ (ℓ : ZMod M) = (legendreSym ℓ A.det : ℂ)) :
    Multipliable (fun p : Nat.Primes => ‖correctedLocalDensityFactor M χ A p‖) :=
  (multipliable_correctedLocalDensityFactor M χ A hA hdet hχ).norm

end QuaternaryQuadraticForms

import QuaternaryQuadraticForms.LocalDensityDefinitions
import QuaternaryQuadraticForms.PrimePowerScalarDecomposition

/-!
# Exact reduction of the scalar sums in the local density count

Cancelling a common scalar and modulus factor leaves four free residue digits.
Together with the unit/multiple partition this gives the finite recurrence for
the full additive-character count, without a nonsingularity or odd-prime condition.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace QuaternaryQuadraticForms

open scoped BigOperators

/-- Cancelling the factor `n` in the scalar coefficient and modulus leaves
exactly `n^4` vector lifts. Both positive moduli may have common prime factors. -/
theorem integralQuadraticGaussSum_scaled_modulus (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] [NeZero n]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (a : ℤ) :
    integralQuadraticGaussSum (m * n) A ((n : ℤ) * a) 0 =
      (n : ℂ) ^ 4 * integralQuadraticGaussSum m A a 0 := by
  classical
  simp only [integralQuadraticGaussSum_eq_lift_sum, zero_dotProduct, add_zero]
  simp_rw [mul_assoc, stdAddChar_mul_modulus]
  rw [sum_residueLift_digits m n]
  have hphase (r : Fin 4 → ZMod m) (s : Fin 4 → ZMod n) :
      ZMod.stdAddChar (N := m)
        ((a * integralQuadraticValue A
          (fun i => residueLift m r i + (m : ℤ) * residueLift n s i) : ℤ) : ZMod m) =
      ZMod.stdAddChar (N := m)
        ((a * integralQuadraticValue A (residueLift m r) : ℤ) : ZMod m) := by
    congr 1
    push_cast
    rw [integralQuadraticValue_congr_mod m A _ (residueLift m r)
      (fun i => by simp)]
  simp_rw [hphase]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun,
    Fintype.card_fin, ZMod.card, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_pow]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]

/-- The full scalar Gauss sum at the next prime power consists of the unit
complete sum and `p^4` times the preceding full scalar Gauss sum. -/
theorem primePower_fullGauss_recurrence (p k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) :
    (∑ a : ZMod (p ^ (k + 1)),
      quadraticGaussSum (p ^ (k + 1)) (A.map (Int.castRingHom _)) a 0) =
      unweightedCompleteSum (p ^ (k + 1)) A 0 +
        (p : ℂ) ^ 4 * ∑ b : ZMod (p ^ k),
          quadraticGaussSum (p ^ k) (A.map (Int.castRingHom _)) b 0 := by
  classical
  rw [pow_succ, sum_primePower_scalars]
  rw [unweightedCompleteSum_eq_sum_quadraticGaussSum]
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply, Int.cast_zero]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  simpa only [integralQuadraticGaussSum, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast,
    ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, Pi.zero_apply, Int.cast_zero] using
    integralQuadraticGaussSum_scaled_modulus (p ^ k) p A (b.val : ℤ)

end QuaternaryQuadraticForms

import QuaternaryQuadraticForms.LocalDensityDefinitions
import QuaternaryQuadraticForms.GoodUnweightedCompleteSum
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Normed

/-!
# The exact local series at a good prime

The coefficients are the existing complete sums. Their prime-power evaluation
and the actual Euler totient give a geometric series, including its separate
modulus-one term. No value or convergence of the local density is assumed.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace QuaternaryQuadraticForms

open scoped BigOperators

/-- The exponent-zero term is the actual modulus-one complete sum. -/
@[simp]
theorem localDensityTerm_zero (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) : localDensityTerm p A 0 = 1 := by
  simp [localDensityTerm, unweightedCompleteSum_one]

/-- The source Legendre coefficient has complex norm at most one. -/
theorem legendreSym_complex_norm_le_one (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (a : ℤ) :
    ‖(legendreSym p a : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
  rw [← globalQuadraticChar_prime]
  rcases jacobiSym.trichotomy a p with h | h | h <;>
    simp [globalQuadraticChar, h]

/-- The ratio of the good-prime geometric series has norm strictly below one. -/
theorem localDensity_goodPrime_ratio_norm_lt_one (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) :
    ‖(legendreSym p A.det : ℂ) / (p : ℂ)‖ < 1 := by
  have hp : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt
  rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_natCast]
  exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (legendreSym_complex_norm_le_one p A.det)
    (by positivity)).trans_lt ((div_lt_one (by positivity)).mpr hp)

/-- At every positive exponent the actual coefficient is the stated
geometric term, with no determinant or character value cancelled. -/
theorem localDensityTerm_goodPrime_succ (p k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A)
    (hp : ¬p ∣ quadraticBadPrimeModulus A) :
    localDensityTerm p A (k + 1) =
      (1 - 1 / (p : ℂ)) * ((legendreSym p A.det : ℂ) / (p : ℂ)) ^ (k + 1) := by
  have hp0 : (p : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
  have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_le
  rw [localDensityTerm, unweightedCompleteSum_prime_power p (k + 1) (by omega)
    A hA hp]
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_zero, dotProduct_zero, integralRamanujanSum_zero,
    Nat.totient_prime_pow_succ (Fact.out : p.Prime), Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow,
    Nat.cast_sub hp1, Nat.cast_one]
  have h2 : (p : ℂ) ^ (2 * (k + 1)) = (p ^ k : ℂ) ^ 2 * p ^ 2 := by
    rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, pow_add, Nat.mul_comm 2 k, pow_mul]
  have h4 : (p : ℂ) ^ (4 * (k + 1)) = (p ^ k : ℂ) ^ 4 * p ^ 4 := by
    rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, pow_add, Nat.mul_comm 4 k, pow_mul]
  rw [h2, h4, div_pow, pow_succ (p : ℂ) k]
  field_simp
  <;> ring

/-- The good-prime local series has exactly the rational value in
`eq:sigmagood`. The denominator is nonzero by the geometric ratio bound. -/
theorem localDensityTerm_hasSum_goodPrime (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A)
    (hp : ¬p ∣ quadraticBadPrimeModulus A) :
    HasSum (localDensityTerm p A)
      ((1 - (legendreSym p A.det : ℂ) / (p : ℂ) ^ 2) /
        (1 - (legendreSym p A.det : ℂ) / (p : ℂ))) := by
  let r : ℂ := (legendreSym p A.det : ℂ) / (p : ℂ)
  have hr : ‖r‖ < 1 := localDensity_goodPrime_ratio_norm_lt_one p A
  have hp0 : (p : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
  have hr1 : 1 - r ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h' : r = 1 := (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
    simpa [h'] using hr
  have ht : HasSum (fun k => localDensityTerm p A (k + 1))
      (((1 - 1 / (p : ℂ)) * r) * (1 - r)⁻¹) := by
    convert (hasSum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hr).mul_left ((1 - 1 / (p : ℂ)) * r)
      using 1
    ext k
    rw [localDensityTerm_goodPrime_succ p k A hA hp, pow_succ]
    dsimp [r]
    ring
  have hfull := (hasSum_nat_add_iff 1).mp ht
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_one, localDensityTerm_zero] at hfull
  convert hfull using 1
  dsimp [r] at hr1 ⊢
  field_simp
  <;> ring

end QuaternaryQuadraticForms

import QuaternaryQuadraticForms.LocalDensityDefinitions
import QuaternaryQuadraticForms.BadPrimeBound
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Normed

/-!
# Absolute convergence of every local density series

The uniform complete-sum bound applies at all prime powers, including powers
of two and of the bad primes. Dividing by the exact fourth-power normalization
gives a summable geometric majorant. No local nonsingularity is required.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace QuaternaryQuadraticForms

open scoped BigOperators

/-- The actual local coefficient has the uniform geometric majorant supplied
by Lemma 3.3, including the coefficient at exponent zero. -/
theorem localDensityTerm_norm_le (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0)
    (k : ℕ) :
    ‖localDensityTerm p A k‖ ≤
      4 * Real.sqrt |(A.det : ℝ)| * (1 / (p : ℝ)) ^ k := by
  have hp : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast NeZero.ne p
  have hb := bad_prime_bound (p ^ k) A hA hdet 0
  rw [localDensityTerm, norm_div, norm_pow, Complex.norm_natCast]
  calc
    _ ≤ (4 * Real.sqrt |(A.det : ℝ)| * (p : ℝ) ^ (3 * k)) /
        (p : ℝ) ^ (4 * k) := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
      simpa only [Nat.cast_pow, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm k 3] using hb
    _ = (4 * Real.sqrt |(A.det : ℝ)| * (p : ℝ) ^ (3 * k)) /
        ((p : ℝ) ^ (3 * k) * (p : ℝ) ^ k) := by
      rw [← pow_add]
      congr 2
      omega
    _ = (4 * Real.sqrt |(A.det : ℝ)|) / (p : ℝ) ^ k := by
      rw [mul_comm (4 * Real.sqrt |(A.det : ℝ)|) _,
        mul_div_mul_left _ _ (pow_ne_zero _ hp)]
    _ = _ := by rw [one_div_pow, div_eq_mul_inv, one_div]

/-- The local series is absolutely convergent at every prime, with no
restriction on whether that prime divides the determinant. -/
theorem summable_norm_localDensityTerm (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => ‖localDensityTerm p A k‖) := by
  have hp : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt
  have hg : Summable (fun k : ℕ => (1 / (p : ℝ)) ^ k) :=
    summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by positivity) ((div_lt_one (by positivity)).2 hp)
  exact (hg.mul_left (4 * Real.sqrt |(A.det : ℝ)|)).of_nonneg_of_le
    (fun k => norm_nonneg (localDensityTerm p A k))
    (fun k => localDensityTerm_norm_le p A hA hdet k)

/-- The literal complex local complete-sum series is summable at every prime. -/
theorem summable_localDensityTerm (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℤ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (hdet : A.det ≠ 0) :
    Summable (localDensityTerm p A) :=
  (summable_norm_localDensityTerm p A hA hdet).of_norm

end QuaternaryQuadraticForms

import QuaternaryQuadraticForms.PrimePowerResidues
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Prime.Basic

/-!
# Splitting actual prime-power scalar residues

The nonunits modulo `p^(k+1)` are precisely the multiples of `p` obtained
from residues modulo `p^k`. The proof constructs both parts using actual
canonical residue digits, and includes `k=0`.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace QuaternaryQuadraticForms

open scoped BigOperators

private def scalarDigits (p k : ℕ) [NeZero p] :
    ZMod p × ZMod (p ^ k) ≃ ZMod (p ^ k * p) :=
  (residueDigitsEquiv p (p ^ k)).trans
    (ZMod.ringEquivCongr (Nat.mul_comm p (p ^ k))).toEquiv

private theorem scalarDigits_val (p k : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (r : ZMod p) (s : ZMod (p ^ k)) :
    (scalarDigits p k (r, s)).val = r.val + p * s.val := by
  simp only [scalarDigits, Equiv.trans_apply, RingEquiv.toEquiv_eq_coe,
    RingEquiv.coe_toEquiv, ZMod.ringEquivCongr_val, residueDigitsEquiv_val]

private theorem scalarDigits_coprime (p k : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (r : ZMod p) (s : ZMod (p ^ k)) :
    Nat.Coprime (scalarDigits p k (r, s)).val (p ^ k * p) ↔
      Nat.Coprime r.val p := by
  rw [scalarDigits_val, ← pow_succ,
    Nat.coprime_pow_right_iff (Nat.succ_pos k), Nat.coprime_add_mul_left_left]

private def scalarUnitDigits (p k : ℕ) [NeZero p] :
    (ZMod p)ˣ × ZMod (p ^ k) ≃ (ZMod (p ^ k * p))ˣ :=
  (Equiv.prodCongr (ZMod.unitsEquivCoprime (n := p))
    (Equiv.refl (ZMod (p ^ k)))).trans
    (Equiv.prodSubtypeFstEquivSubtypeProd.symm.trans
      (((scalarDigits p k).subtypeEquiv
        (fun rs => (scalarDigits_coprime p k rs.1 rs.2).symm)).trans
        (ZMod.unitsEquivCoprime (n := p ^ k * p)).symm))

private theorem scalarUnitDigits_coe (p k : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (a : (ZMod p)ˣ) (s : ZMod (p ^ k)) :
    (scalarUnitDigits p k (a, s) : ZMod (p ^ k * p)) =
      scalarDigits p k ((a : ZMod p), s) := by
  change (((scalarDigits p k ((a : ZMod p), s)).val : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ k * p)) = _
  exact ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _

/-- Every scalar residue is either an actual unit or a unique multiple of `p`
lifted from the preceding power. This exact sum partition also holds at `k=0`. -/
theorem sum_primePower_scalars (p k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : ZMod (p ^ k * p) → ℂ) :
    (∑ a : ZMod (p ^ k * p), f a) =
      (∑ a : (ZMod (p ^ k * p))ˣ, f (a : ZMod (p ^ k * p))) +
        ∑ b : ZMod (p ^ k), f ((p : ZMod (p ^ k * p)) * b.val) := by
  classical
  have hu :
      (∑ a : (ZMod (p ^ k * p))ˣ, f (a : ZMod (p ^ k * p))) =
        ∑ a : (ZMod p)ˣ, ∑ b : ZMod (p ^ k),
          f (scalarDigits p k ((a : ZMod p), b)) := by
    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (scalarUnitDigits p k)
      (fun a : (ZMod (p ^ k * p))ˣ => f (a : ZMod (p ^ k * p))),
      Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp only [scalarUnitDigits_coe]
  have hz (b : ZMod (p ^ k)) :
      scalarDigits p k (0, b) = (p : ZMod (p ^ k * p)) * b.val := by
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (scalarDigits p k (0, b)), scalarDigits_val]
    simp
  calc
    _ = ∑ r : ZMod p, ∑ b : ZMod (p ^ k), f (scalarDigits p k (r, b)) := by
      rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (scalarDigits p k) f, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    _ = (∑ b : ZMod (p ^ k), f (scalarDigits p k (0, b))) +
        ∑ r : {r : ZMod p // r ≠ 0}, ∑ b : ZMod (p ^ k),
          f (scalarDigits p k (r.val, b)) := by
      exact Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne _ 0
    _ = (∑ b : ZMod (p ^ k), f ((p : ZMod (p ^ k * p)) * b.val)) +
        ∑ a : (ZMod p)ˣ, ∑ b : ZMod (p ^ k),
          f (scalarDigits p k ((a : ZMod p), b)) := by
      rw [← Equiv.sum_comp unitsEquivNeZero
        (fun r : {r : ZMod p // r ≠ 0} =>
          ∑ b : ZMod (p ^ k), f (scalarDigits p k (r.val, b)))]
      simp only [hz]
    _ = _ := by rw [← hu, add_comm]

end QuaternaryQuadraticForms
